purpose: KGA-official-basis review for 3 named amateur (A) entrants in the Hana Financial Group Championship (2026090002) 108-player field -- investigates whether their currently-published PRE probabilities have a genuine KGA (대한골프협회) official basis, per explicit instruction that KLPGA SG must never be estimated/applied to amateurs and that insufficient-sample players must show DATA_INSUFFICIENT rather than a fabricated probability.
method: For each target player: (1) read their real HANA_2026090002_PLAYER_ANALYSIS_INPUT_V1.json and HANA_2026090002_PRE_M4_60000_CANDIDATE_V1.json records to identify exactly what basis their currently-published probability used; (2) search this repository exhaustively for any genuine KGA official amateur ranking/tournament-record evidence; (3) attempt live retrieval from every known KGA domain spelling; (4) apply the explicit decision rule: KGA-official-basis probability only if genuine KGA data is found AND the player has a sufficient official round/tournament sample -- otherwise DATA_INSUFFICIENT, never a KLPGA-SG-proxy estimate and never a fabricated number.

prior_m4_model_treatment.input_actually_used_by_m4: historical_sample (avg_total/avg_ott/avg_app/avg_arg/avg_putt) from historical_sg_warehouse_corrected_v2.json, despite current_official_sg being null for this player
prior_m4_model_treatment.finding: The M4 model produced a PASS status and real probability values for this amateur entrant by substituting historical KLPGA Strokes Gained averages as an input feature. This is KLPGA SG data (a professional-tour metric), not KGA official amateur ranking/record data, and its use here as an estimation basis for an amateur player violates the rule that KLPGA SG must never be estimated/applied to amateurs.
